items.name: Alsona
items.tagline: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
items.description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

items.name: Maxma
items.tagline: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
items.description: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

items.name: Latch.ai
items.tagline: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
items.description: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

items.name: Opal Reader
items.tagline: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo
items.description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

items.name: TK by Medium
items.tagline: An agentic notebook to build your best thinking
items.description: What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools.

items.name: Seldon
items.tagline: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do
items.description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

items.name: Lottie AI
items.tagline: Editable vector animations from a text prompt
items.description: Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

items.name: Co-Review
items.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
items.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

items.name: ChromePing
items.tagline: Talk to anyone by phone, in a language you don't speak
items.description: Move somewhere you don't speak the language and the phone becomes a wall — the immigration office, your bank, a landlord, a clinic, even ordering food. The usual fix is bringing a human translator, if you can find one. ChromePing lets you call any real phone number — mobile or landline, anywhere — from your browser. No app to install, yours or theirs. The call is translated live, both ways, with captions. Whoever you call just answers their normal phone. Pay as you go, no subscription.

items.name: Ember
items.tagline: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click
items.description: Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

items.name: Coffee
items.tagline: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes
items.description: Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

items.name: MuJoCo 4
items.tagline: A physics engine for robots with its own studio
items.description: MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

items.name: SideKick By Open
items.tagline: “Claude, but for your product” is here.
items.description: Make your product agentic in one click. Sidekick puts an AI agent inside your own product. Customers say what they need in one sentence and Sidekick does the work, long-horizon tasks, reports, actions, even navigating the UI for them. It's MCP-compatible, so it connects to the tools they already use. Sidekick is connected to the main Open platform, a full-stack customer communications engine: the same engine behind AI customer support and Open for Sales, now inside your product.

items.name: AppuBot
items.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
items.description: AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

items.name: Almanzor
items.tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
items.description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

items.name: Rodeo
items.tagline: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan
items.description: Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

items.name: AppTraction
items.tagline: Supercharge Apple App Store analytics
items.description: AppTraction is a native Mac app that makes App Store Connect make sense. Your sales, analytics, ratings, and reviews live on your Mac and appear instantly. It monitors your apps, flags problems, trends, and milestones, and writes weekly, monthly, and annual reports. Its AI evaluates your listing and helps fix it, and you can chat about any chart or report. It’s primed with Apple’s own ASO advice and uses your existing Claude or Codex subscription. Your data is stored only on your Mac.

items.name: Quillo
items.tagline: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai
items.description: Quillo reads PDFs, Word files, photos and web pages aloud in a natural voice and highlights each sentence. Quillo Ai answers questions about your documents. Merge, compress, sign, scan and convert for free on Android, iPhone and the web.

items.name: ForAgent
items.tagline: Private phone numbers so AI agents can call each other
items.description: ForAgent gives your AI agents private phone numbers so they can talk to each other, on your own computers or with other people. Handle calls in our app, or right inside your AI with the plugin. You choose who gets through.

items.name: gitmanual
items.tagline: See if a GitHub repo runs on your OS, and how to set it up
items.description: Know if a GitHub project will run on your computer before you clone it. Paste any repo link and get its setup manual: a yes/no verdict for macOS, Windows or Linux, everything you need to install, and the exact steps, or one setup script. It reads the repo's own files, no AI guessing, and links to the maintainers' guide when unsure. Swap "hub" for "manual" in any GitHub URL, use the Chrome extension, or the MCP server for AI assistants. Works on private repos. Free and open source.
